name: v0.4.15
body:
## What's Changed
* test(java): follow #1315's English words in two stale router tests by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1323
* fix(laya-ts): spell floats >= 1e16 like CPython in serializeState by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1341
* fix(dotnet): parse and re-emit JSON without recursion, so depth cannot overflow the stack by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1346
* fix(ci): run the real bf16 forward in the child, not a stand-in by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1347
* docs(hooks): align calibration input and fixture requirements by @xinpingzh in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1348
* perf(lang): optimize unicode script detection with binary search by @HamidRezaLS in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1349
* build(deps): bump github/codeql-action/init from 4.38.3 to 4.39.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1353
* build(deps): bump github/codeql-action/analyze from 4.38.3 to 4.39.1 by @dependabot[bot] in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1356
* fix(evals): a threshold names its metric, and noul_accuracy is not choice_accuracy by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1317
* fix(evals): a gate policy nested too deep for json is a usage error, not a crash by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1318
* fix(evals): a dataset that cannot be read is a usage error, not a traceback by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1319
* fix(evidence): a too-deep JSON artifact names the file it came from by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1320
* fix(integrations): refuse a remote answers field that is not an object by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1321
* fix(evals): refuse a dataset row that is not a row as an EvalError by @aashish254 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1322
* test(rust): pin Python 0.4.14's English question words and sample its live vocabulary by @kevin-gatimu in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1325
* fix(agent): allow end hooks to remove long-scan probe answers by @Boulea7 in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1326
* fix(java): copy AgentConfig's temperature table instead of aliasing it by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1327
* fix(java): close the ONNX session options, and a half-built split graph by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1328
* fix(java): leave nothing that can throw between taking a router lease and releasing it by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1329
* fix(lang): describe the state in analyse, and round rates like Python by @cyberspace-cs in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1330
* fix(serve): bound the request-body read so a stalled upload frees its slot by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1331
* fix(serve): a caller batch_size may shrink a pass, never widen one by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1332
* fix(serve): serve no docs or schema when a bearer is required by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1333
* fix(lang): count letters the interpreter's Unicode database does not know by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1334
* fix(integrations): fail closed on malformed nested decision fields by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1335
* fix(laya-ts): stop reading all-caps lines as French or Portuguese by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1336
* fix(laya-ts): forward a detected "en" so lang_temperatures.en applies by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1337
* fix(laya-ts): forward maxLen / headMaxLen through Router.predict by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1338
* fix(laya-ts): end batch request contexts in reverse start order by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1339
* fix(laya-ts): forward per-call hooks through decideBatch on a Router by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1340
* fix(laya-ts): take the noul enum shortcut only for two distinct booleans by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1342
* fix(typescript-sdk): accept option_order and noul labels on a question by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1343
* fix(rust,dotnet): clip shortlist cosines to the documented [-1, 1] by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1344
* chore(rust): record 0.4.14 in the routing golden meta by @thread3d in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1345

## New Contributors
* @Boulea7 made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1326
* @cyberspace-cs made their first contribution in https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/pull/1330

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/NandhaKishorM/laya/compare/v0.4.14...v0.4.15
